traits.clonal.note: Dransfield et al. (Genera Palmarum, 2nd ed., 2008), under the genus: its stems are solitary; its tubular leaf sheaths form a crownshaft below the leaves.

generator.params.crownshaft.why: A crownshaft of leaf sheaths, about four tenths of a frond long (the built-in royal palm's is 2 m under 3.5 m fronds).
